Date: Sat, 18 Apr 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial DPA / SCCs + Order Form questions (ClearBridge)

Sana / team — thanks for the detail. I reviewed the attached preferences and Ben's redlines and pulled together a concise negotiation plan and the priority DPA changes we expect to discuss. Summary below (we'll walk through each item on Tue):

1) SCCs baseline: we will adopt the EU SCCs (processors to processors module where applicable) and keep an explicit reference to the Commission's 2021 Decision. Redline language will include: identification of roles (controller/processor mapping), scope of processing, and permitted transfers.

2) Roles & Responsibilities: clarify processor-only obligations (security, deletion, subprocessor onboarding) versus controller obligations. We will propose a short Exhibit mapping order form services to processing activities and data categories.

3) Subprocessors: Redwood will provide a snapshot of the subprocessor register (CSV) and will commit to weekly email digests for material changes. We will accept a 30-day notice period for new subprocessors with a carveout for emergency security patches.

4) KMS / Key control: CMK is supported on Dedicated/Private. For Hosted, we offer BYOK integrations for enterprise customers with an approved onboarding plan. We will include audit artifacts: key usage logs (redacted) and rotation certificates for the last 90 days on request under NDA.

5) Transfer Impact Addendum (TIA): we'll share the TIA template showing technical/organizational mitigations (encryption-at-rest/in-transit, access controls, staff access policies) and our reliance on SCCs plus contractual controls. We'll include a short narrative on risk mitigation for US processing centers.

6) Audit & Inspection: we will push for acceptance of SOC2 reports for control assurance, limited targeted on-site inspections only for material incidents, and a pre-approved scope for any inspection to protect production systems.

7) Liability & Remedies: propose a tailored liability cap tied to fees paid in prior 12 months, carveouts for gross negligence and willful misconduct, and a defined process for security credits.

Attachments: redline_summary.pdf (one-page negotiation asks) and updated redline_dpa_v1.docx (minor edits). We'll circulate an agenda for Tue with time allocated to each topic (20m DPA, 15m KMS/subprocessor, 10m procurement).

If that plan looks good to ClearBridge, we'll finalize a MAP after the call with owners and target dates.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Privacy
Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai
